title: Budget Years
hook: Four years, one district, never enough money. Keep the grade at 3.2.
text: Four budget years as the asset manager of the district around Bf Neustadt, alone: each year the maintenance strategy, the renewals, the emergency teams and, now and then, a proposal of the asset responsible (ALV); then the year plays out: faults, delay minutes, the condition grade, the money. The target is a grade of 3.2 or better with the inspections on time and no replacement money left unused.

story.say: Welcome to the district: 150 km of track. One thing I have learned out there: whatever you save on maintenance this year, I find again as faults next year.

debrief: Which decision moved the condition grade most, and when did its effect show?
Replacement money is lost when it is not spent in its year. What did that rule make you do?
A known defect can be deferred. What would have to be true for deferring it to be the right decision?
